title: Graph comparison identifies the support compositor with nested sum composition
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, and let U --e--> X --v--> T be separated, quasi-compact etale arrows of Noetherian schemes. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-A module sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For arbitrary compactifications c of e, d of v and k of e followed by v [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], let alpha be the proper/open compositor transported to c,d,k by the every-tower construction of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let d_e,d_v,d_ve be the inverse constructed graph comparison isomorphisms of [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-derived-isomorphism], and let sigma be the exact derived nested-sum compositor of [lem-pur-etale-sum-composition-counit]. Then alpha followed by d_ve equals the horizontal composite of d_e and d_v followed by sigma, as natural transformations on the entire unbounded derived categories. This is an equality of the specified maps, with no adjunction or right-adjoint choices.

proof.text: Prove the natural-transformation equality by extensionality on every derived-category object and apply the component support/sum compositor equation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSupportSumCompositor
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian T]
    (e : U ⟶ X) (v : X ⟶ T)
    [Etale e] [Etale v] [IsSeparated e] [IsSeparated v]
    [QuasiCompact e] [QuasiCompact v]
    (c : Compactification e) (d : Compactification v) (k : Compactification (e ≫ v)) :
    (Functor.isoWhiskerRight
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso A c (k.ofComp d).restrict) _ ≪≫
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationCompIso A d (k.ofComp d) ≪≫
      rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso A (d.comp (k.ofComp d)) k).hom ≫
        (canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A (e ≫ v) k).hom =
      NatTrans.hcomp (canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A e c).hom
          (canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A v d).hom ≫
        (derivedEtaleSumCompIso A e v).hom
